title: Project Profile (project.yml)
description: Human-authored profile for one project at projects/<slug>/project.yml. Sets the tier (the dial) plus stack-specific bindings. A minimal profile need only set name, tier, goal, and commands; everything else is filled from tiers.yml. This is where ALL platform specifics live so the shared playbooks stay stack-neutral.

name.description: kebab-case project slug; also the folder name under projects/.

status.description: Project lifecycle. A closed project's folder moves to archive/.

repos.description: Absolute paths of the repositories this project works in. The first entry is the primary repo.

repo.description: Single-repo alias for `repos: [<path>]`. Accepted for backwards compatibility; prefer `repos`.

subdirs.description: Repo-relative path prefixes this project owns. Use when several projects share one repo.

folders.description: Extra knowledge-base folders (relative to the knowledge base root) that belong to this project besides projects/<slug>/.

resources.description: Linked external resources: tickets, chat threads, docs, PRs, dashboards.

kind.description: Free tag, e.g. ticket, thread, doc, pr, dashboard.

ticket.description: Ticket id this resource relates to, if any.

commands.description: STACK BINDING. Abstract gate names -> real shell commands. Playbooks reference these names, never a tool. Leave a value empty/null if the project has no such step.

integrations.description: Every external tool call in a playbook is guarded by `enabled`. Off by default -> the project works fully local with no hosted git, issue tracker, or CI.

pipeline.description: Defaults come from the tier; override here only to deviate.

tracker.description: Path to tracker.json or checklist.md, relative to the project folder. May point at an externally kept tracker.

owns_skills.description: Optional. If a project hosts its own specialized skills/workflows, list them so /orchestrate defers to them instead of driving the generic pipeline.
